name: Accuracy / exact-set accuracy
definition: 100 * correct exact label predictions / 100 planned items. Invalid/abstaining outputs are incorrect; unattempted items keep the row partial.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Valid-output accuracy
definition: 100 * exact correct / valid parsed predictions; diagnostic only; always show valid N.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Micro precision
definition: Compute precision using micro averaging over the fixed label inventory (2 or 28). zero_division=0; report per-label support. Weighted uses GT support. Requires all planned outputs valid; otherwise NC with failure-aware Acc reported.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Micro recall
definition: Compute recall using micro averaging over the fixed label inventory (2 or 28). zero_division=0; report per-label support. Weighted uses GT support. Requires all planned outputs valid; otherwise NC with failure-aware Acc reported.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Micro f1
definition: Compute f1 using micro averaging over the fixed label inventory (2 or 28). zero_division=0; report per-label support. Weighted uses GT support. Requires all planned outputs valid; otherwise NC with failure-aware Acc reported.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Macro precision
definition: Compute precision using macro averaging over the fixed label inventory (2 or 28). zero_division=0; report per-label support. Weighted uses GT support. Requires all planned outputs valid; otherwise NC with failure-aware Acc reported.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Macro recall
definition: Compute recall using macro averaging over the fixed label inventory (2 or 28). zero_division=0; report per-label support. Weighted uses GT support. Requires all planned outputs valid; otherwise NC with failure-aware Acc reported.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Macro f1
definition: Compute f1 using macro averaging over the fixed label inventory (2 or 28). zero_division=0; report per-label support. Weighted uses GT support. Requires all planned outputs valid; otherwise NC with failure-aware Acc reported.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Weighted precision
definition: Compute precision using weighted averaging over the fixed label inventory (2 or 28). zero_division=0; report per-label support. Weighted uses GT support. Requires all planned outputs valid; otherwise NC with failure-aware Acc reported.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Weighted recall
definition: Compute recall using weighted averaging over the fixed label inventory (2 or 28). zero_division=0; report per-label support. Weighted uses GT support. Requires all planned outputs valid; otherwise NC with failure-aware Acc reported.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Weighted f1
definition: Compute f1 using weighted averaging over the fixed label inventory (2 or 28). zero_division=0; report per-label support. Weighted uses GT support. Requires all planned outputs valid; otherwise NC with failure-aware Acc reported.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Stress-positive F1
definition: F1 for stress=1; zero_division=0. Never silently use no-stress as the positive class.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Balanced accuracy
definition: Mean recall across both GT classes; undefined if either class is absent.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Specificity
definition: 100 * TN/(TN+FP), positive class stress=1; undefined with no negatives.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Matthews correlation coefficient
definition: Binary MCC; report degeneracy and support; use pinned sklearn convention for constant predictions.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Cohen kappa against GT
definition: Observed versus chance-corrected binary label agreement; undefined degenerate marginal cases marked NC.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Confusion matrix
definition: Dreaddit 2x2 and GoEmotions per-label 2x2 matrices with fixed label order.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Per-label precision / recall / F1 / support
definition: Vector over the full label inventory, including zero-support labels and zero_division=0.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Macro-F1 on supported labels
definition: Average F1 only over labels with GT support >0; diagnostic alongside fixed-28 Macro-F1; save label list.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Sample-averaged precision
definition: Mean per-item set precision; zero_division=0. Normalize neutral as a real single label, not an empty set.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Sample-averaged recall
definition: Mean per-item set recall; zero_division=0. Normalize neutral as a real single label, not an empty set.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Sample-averaged f1
definition: Mean per-item set f1; zero_division=0. Normalize neutral as a real single label, not an empty set.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Hamming loss
definition: 100 * total false-positive and false-negative label bits / (100 * 28). Requires all valid predictions; also show F1 because absent labels dominate.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Sample Jaccard
definition: Mean 100 * |predicted intersection GT| / |predicted union GT|; empty union convention 1, though valid GT is nonempty.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Predicted / true label cardinality
definition: Mean labels per item for predictions and GT, plus signed and absolute differences.
requires: Saved predictions and released GT

name: Empty / neutral-conflict output rates
definition: Separate rates for empty label sets and neutral combined with another emotion. Flag as invalid under the frozen schema.
requires: Saved predictions and frozen label schema

name: ROC-AUC
definition: Dreaddit positive-class AUC; GoEmotions per-label, micro, and macro AUC. Skip undefined single-class labels, list them and the averaging denominator.
requires: Comparable probabilities/scores from a separately frozen scoring procedure; never infer these from hard labels or verbal confidence

name: Average precision
definition: Dreaddit positive-class AP; GoEmotions micro/macro/per-label AP. Report undefined/no-positive labels and valid averaging denominator; do not call trapezoidal PR-AUC AP.
requires: Comparable probabilities/scores from a separately frozen scoring procedure; never infer these from hard labels or verbal confidence

name: Brier score
definition: Dreaddit mean (p_stress-y)^2; GoEmotions mean over all N*28 squared marginal probability errors.
requires: Comparable probabilities/scores from a separately frozen scoring procedure; never infer these from hard labels or verbal confidence

name: Log loss
definition: Dreaddit binary NLL; GoEmotions mean binary cross-entropy over N*28. Clip probabilities at 1e-7; record clipping.
requires: Comparable probabilities/scores from a separately frozen scoring procedure; never infer these from hard labels or verbal confidence

name: Expected calibration error
definition: Ten equal-width bins over [0,1]. Binary positive-probability ECE or pooled multi-label-bit ECE; save bin N, mean predicted probability and positive frequency.
requires: Comparable probabilities/scores from a separately frozen scoring procedure; never infer these from hard labels or verbal confidence

name: Label-ranking average precision
definition: GoEmotions only: use complete marginal score vector and GT label matrix.
requires: Comparable probabilities/scores from a separately frozen scoring procedure; never infer these from hard labels or verbal confidence

name: Label-ranking loss
definition: GoEmotions only: fraction of incorrectly ordered relevant/irrelevant label pairs under pinned sklearn convention.
requires: Comparable probabilities/scores from a separately frozen scoring procedure; never infer these from hard labels or verbal confidence

name: Coverage error
definition: GoEmotions only: average depth required to cover all true labels in score ranking; not prediction coverage.
requires: Comparable probabilities/scores from a separately frozen scoring procedure; never infer these from hard labels or verbal confidence

name: Risk-coverage curve / AURC
definition: Order items by predeclared confidence in exact answer correctness; plot full-panel exact-error rate among retained items. Confidence construction must be calibrated on development data.
requires: Comparable probabilities/scores from a separately frozen scoring procedure; never infer these from hard labels or verbal confidence

name: Reliability diagram data
definition: Per-bin counts, mean probabilities, observed frequencies; export machine-readable bin records.
requires: Same valid probabilities as ECE

name: Conformability v2 pass rate
definition: Pass iff all four source-grounding dimensions score 2 and output is valid. Report passes/resolved and resolved/100; final only with 100 resolved.
requires: Frozen primary judge, source, task/codebook, final answer/evidence

name: Factual support
definition: Mean dimension rating 0=fail, 1=partial/ambiguous, 2=pass over resolved ratings; show dimension-specific N and missing.
requires: Frozen dimension rubric and judge

name: Evidence relevance
definition: Mean dimension rating 0=fail, 1=partial/ambiguous, 2=pass over resolved ratings; show dimension-specific N and missing.
requires: Frozen dimension rubric and judge

name: Speaker / temporal attribution
definition: Mean dimension rating 0=fail, 1=partial/ambiguous, 2=pass over resolved ratings; show dimension-specific N and missing.
requires: Frozen dimension rubric and judge

name: Absence of material unsupported assertions
definition: Mean dimension rating 0=fail, 1=partial/ambiguous, 2=pass over resolved ratings; show dimension-specific N and missing.
requires: Frozen dimension rubric and judge

name: Claim support rate
definition: Supported atomic claims / all adjudicated atomic claims; show number of claims and extraction version. Empty answers do not earn a perfect score.
requires: Additional frozen claim decomposition and claim-level annotations

name: Contradiction rate
definition: Contradicted atomic claims / adjudicated claims; unclear claims separately reported.
requires: Claim-level source judgments

name: Exact-quote validity
definition: Quotes whose stored [start,end) offsets reproduce the quote exactly / all submitted quotes. Missing all required quotes is an item failure.
requires: Final evidence quotes, Unicode codepoint offsets and original source

name: Label-to-evidence coverage
definition: Predicted labels/codes with at least one mechanically valid quote / predicted labels/codes; empty invalid output has coverage 0, never 100.
requires: Label-linked quote records and deterministic quote validator

name: Evidence entailment rate
definition: Label/code claims actually supported by cited spans / judged label/code claims. Report all predicted-label denominator and missing separately.
requires: Frozen entailment rubric and judge

name: Evidence token F1 / span overlap
definition: Token overlap against independently annotated gold spans using a frozen tokenizer and multi-span matching rule.
requires: Human reference evidence; not available for the current panel by default

name: Joint correct-and-grounded rate
definition: Match by record ID: exact label correctness AND Conformability pass. Use actual joint events, never multiply marginal rates. Show missing-grounding bounds.
requires: Released GT and resolved per-item grounding

name: Grounding pass rate among wrong answers
definition: Grounding passes among exact-label errors / resolved exact-label errors. Exposes plausible but incorrect explanations.
requires: Released GT and per-item judge decisions

name: Human-audited grounding pass rate
definition: Adjudicated passes / reviewed outputs using the same v2 rubric; show exact audited N and never extrapolate as full-panel score.
requires: Two independent human reviews plus adjudication

name: Human-human raw agreement / kappa
definition: Pass/fail agreement and Cohen kappa before adjudication; dimension ordinal agreement separately.
requires: Independent reviewer labels

name: Judge-human agreement / sensitivity / specificity
definition: Compare judge with adjudicated human grounding; treat human grounding failures as positive for failure-detection sensitivity. Show confusion matrix.
requires: Judge and human labels; both human outcome classes for sensitivity/specificity

name: Primary-secondary judge agreement
definition: Raw agreement and kappa, same answer/source and frozen rubric; agreement is not proof of truth.
requires: Separately frozen secondary judge; not automatically scheduled

name: Prediction coverage
definition: Valid committed predictions / 100 planned inputs.
requires: Attempt logs and parser/error records

name: Schema-valid output rate
definition: Report first-attempt validity and eventual validity separately over attempted items.
requires: Attempt logs and parser/error records

name: Invalid-label rate
definition: Items with out-of-codebook, duplicate or forbidden label combinations / attempted items.
requires: Attempt logs and parser/error records

name: Abstention / refusal rate
definition: Separate explicit uncertainty abstentions and refusals / attempted items; preserve task failures.
requires: Attempt logs and parser/error records

name: Unresolved judgment rate
definition: Unresolved or unattempted planned primary judgments / 100; split error and not-yet-run counts.
requires: Attempt logs and parser/error records

name: Output-truncation rate
definition: Length-terminated model calls / all completed calls; also items affected / attempted items.
requires: Attempt logs and parser/error records

name: Retry rate
definition: Items needing one or more retries / attempted items; report extra-call count separately.
requires: Attempt logs and parser/error records

name: Exhausted format-failure rate
definition: Items still unparsable after the fixed retry policy / attempted items.
requires: Attempt logs and parser/error records

name: Total active wall time
definition: Wall time spent on preparation, adaptation/search, prediction, judging and retries; sum nonoverlapping phase intervals. Separate cold-start setup.
requires: Stage logs / backend token usage / GPU telemetry or billing as appropriate

name: Elapsed and paused time
definition: End-start elapsed time plus separately measured user-pause, infrastructure-idle and active intervals.
requires: Stage logs / backend token usage / GPU telemetry or billing as appropriate

name: Stage latency mean / p50 / p95
definition: Separate generator, reflector, curator, optimizer and judge latencies; completed versus failed attempts separately.
requires: Stage logs / backend token usage / GPU telemetry or billing as appropriate

name: Online step latency
definition: Time from beginning prediction to committed memory update; include its retries; report mean/p50/p95.
requires: Stage logs / backend token usage / GPU telemetry or billing as appropriate

name: Throughput
definition: Completed valid evaluation items / active prediction wall time; separate token throughput and batch profile.
requires: Stage logs / backend token usage / GPU telemetry or billing as appropriate

name: Input / output / thinking / cached tokens
definition: Totals and per-item mean/p50/p95 by role, with native tokenizer and missing-usage counters.
requires: Stage logs / backend token usage / GPU telemetry or billing as appropriate

name: Model and metric-call counts
definition: Separate inference calls, optimizer metric evaluations, retries, and cache hits; do not equate them.
requires: Stage logs / backend token usage / GPU telemetry or billing as appropriate

name: Discarded inference time
definition: Sum measured duration of canceled, truncated or otherwise unusable calls; distinguish successful fallback calls and unknown cancellation duration.
requires: Stage logs / backend token usage / GPU telemetry or billing as appropriate

name: Peak VRAM
definition: Sample GPU memory at 1 second and store sampling interval; include model and KV cache, not only weight file size.
requires: Stage logs / backend token usage / GPU telemetry or billing as appropriate

name: GPU energy
definition: Integrate measured GPU power over active intervals; report sampling/missing data, excludes unmeasured host energy.
requires: Stage logs / backend token usage / GPU telemetry or billing as appropriate

name: Measured compute cost
definition: Actual billed/API cost or rate-card estimate with explicit tariff, date and active allocation; no invented local dollar costs.
requires: Stage logs / backend token usage / GPU telemetry or billing as appropriate

name: Memory size and growth
definition: Before/after each update: tokens, bytes and stable bullet count where supported; p50/max/final plus growth.
requires: Saved per-item predictions, ordered memory/update logs and applicable GT/judgments

name: Memory additions / edits / removals
definition: Count committed ACE delta operations by type; for DC report whole-cheatsheet revisions without inventing ACE bullet semantics.
requires: Saved per-item predictions, ordered memory/update logs and applicable GT/judgments

name: Rejected / failed memory updates
definition: Rejected over-budget or invalid updates / attempted updates; retained-old-memory events tracked separately.
requires: Saved per-item predictions, ordered memory/update logs and applicable GT/judgments

name: Referenced playbook bullet rate
definition: Valid bullet IDs cited by predictions / total cited IDs; also distinct cited bullets / existing bullets. Self-reported references are not causal utilization.
requires: Saved per-item predictions, ordered memory/update logs and applicable GT/judgments

name: Update completion
definition: Committed required online updates / 100, or offline adaptation updates / 100. No-op valid updates count but are identified.
requires: Saved per-item predictions, ordered memory/update logs and applicable GT/judgments

name: Cumulative and 20-item block curves
definition: Compute applicable task and grounding metrics at prefixes 20,40,60,80,100 and disjoint blocks; include block N and GT support.
requires: Saved per-item predictions, ordered memory/update logs and applicable GT/judgments

name: Matched Base improvement
definition: Same-backbone/seed/item matched difference for applicable metric; percentages expressed in percentage points.
requires: Saved per-item predictions, ordered memory/update logs and applicable GT/judgments

name: Repetition variation
definition: Per-seed scores and mean/sample SD across seeds 42,43,44; never select the best seed or claim N=300 unique examples.
requires: Saved per-item predictions, ordered memory/update logs and applicable GT/judgments

name: Paired 95% confidence interval
definition: 10,000 offline paired group/item bootstrap replicates, seed 20260914; online dependency caveats follow guideline.
requires: Saved per-item predictions, ordered memory/update logs and applicable GT/judgments

name: AppWorld Test-Normal TGC
definition: Official executable task/scenario success metric, not a classification or grounding proxy. N/A for all four corpora.
requires: Official AppWorld task tests, scenarios and split definitions
